properties.name: Intermountain West
properties.note: Backbone scope above both state tags. Drawn as the two states together.

properties.name: Utah
properties.note: State scope. The five regional scopes below tile Utah.

properties.name: Idaho
properties.note: State scope. Southwest, southern, and eastern Idaho follow the Intermountain tree. The panhandle follows the Pacific Northwest hierarchy.

properties.name: Brigham City, Logan, Tremonton
properties.note: Box Elder and Cache counties hold Brigham City, Tremonton, and Logan. Rich County stays on n-ut as the rest of the northern tier.

properties.name: Wasatch Front
properties.note: The urban corridor from Ogden through Utah County, plus Tooele County on the west desert. Ogden, Salt Lake, and Utah County have their own city scopes.

properties.name: Wasatch Back: Park City, Heber, Vernal
properties.note: Summit and Wasatch counties hold Park City and Heber. Duchesne, Uintah, and Daggett carry that scope across the Uinta Basin to Vernal. Morgan sits east of Ogden, behind the Wasatch.

properties.name: Nephi, Moab, Beaver, Richfield
properties.note: Juab, Sevier, Beaver, and Grand counties match the named towns. The counties between them, including Millard, Sanpete, Carbon, Emery, and San Juan, stay on c-ut.

properties.name: Southern Utah
properties.note: Southern Utah splits into Cedar City and St. George. Garfield and Kane counties are the eastern portion of those two scopes.

properties.name: Ogden, Layton, Bountiful, Plain City
properties.note: Weber and Davis counties: Ogden, Plain City, Layton, and Bountiful.

properties.name: Salt Lake City, Draper, West Jordan
properties.note: Salt Lake County, including Salt Lake City, West Jordan, and Draper.

properties.name: Lehi, Provo, Santaquin
properties.note: Utah County, from Lehi through Provo to Santaquin.

properties.name: Cedar City
properties.note: Iron County holds Cedar City. Garfield County (Panguitch and Bryce) is grouped here as the closest southern scope.

properties.name: St. George
properties.note: Washington County holds St. George. Kane County (Kanab) is grouped with it along the Arizona line.

properties.name: Southwest Idaho
properties.note: Southwest Idaho. Ada and Canyon counties are the Boise metro; Emmett, Payette, Weiser, McCall, Mountain Home, and the Owyhee desert stay on sw-id.

properties.name: Southern Idaho
properties.note: South-central Idaho: the Wood River valley and the Magic Valley.

properties.name: Eastern Idaho
properties.note: Eastern Idaho. The Snake River cities have their own scopes. Butte, Clark, Custer, and Lemhi counties stay on e-id.

properties.name: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, Caldwell
properties.note: Ada and Canyon counties: Boise, Meridian, Nampa, and Caldwell. This is the scope that also carries pnw.

properties.name: Twin Falls, Gooding, Jerome, Mini-Cassia, Magic Valley
properties.note: Magic Valley counties: Twin Falls, Gooding, Jerome, Lincoln, Minidoka, and Cassia, plus Camas County on the north edge.

properties.name: Sun Valley, Blaine County
properties.note: Blaine County: Sun Valley, Ketchum, and Hailey.

properties.name: Pocatello, Chubbuck, Malad, Soda Springs
properties.note: Bannock, Oneida, and Caribou counties match Pocatello, Malad, and Soda Springs. Power, Franklin, and Bear Lake stay with them as the rest of the southeast corner.

properties.name: Idaho Falls, Blackfoot
properties.note: Bonneville and Bingham counties hold Idaho Falls and Blackfoot. Jefferson County (Rigby) stays with Idaho Falls.

properties.name: Rexburg
properties.note: Madison County holds Rexburg. Fremont and Teton counties (St. Anthony and Driggs) stay up-valley on mad.

properties.name: Coeur d'Alene / N. Idaho panhandle
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Boundary, Bonner, Kootenai, Benewah, and Shoshone counties: Sandpoint, Coeur d'Alene, and the Silver Valley.

properties.name: Northern Idaho (Moscow, Lewiston, Clearwater)
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. The Palouse and Clearwater are the local scope; Idaho County stays on n-id.

properties.name: Lewiston / Moscow / Clearwater
properties.note: From the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Latah, Nez Perce, Lewis, and Clearwater counties.

properties.name: University of Idaho, Moscow campus
properties.note: Campus-only scope from the Pacific Northwest hierarchy. Drawn as the Moscow campus, inside lws.
